bild_ki.motiv: A row of simple wooden market stalls being opened in the morning, shutters folded up, a vendor seen from behind hanging fir branches over a counter.
bild_ki.umgebung: The long street market square of a Lower Bavarian old town, colourful plastered gabled facades, a tall Gothic brick church tower at the end of the square.
bild_ki.heute: A small electric delivery van parked between the stalls, extension cables and modern LED light strings.
bild_ki.licht: Grey late-November morning, soft diffuse light, damp cobblestones.
